title: SDK: typed exceptions for data residency enforcement + optional client region hint
author: Ibrahim Khan
release_notes: Python SDK now raises typed exceptions for data residency enforcement errors (e.g., RESIDENCY_REGION_MISMATCH) and supports an optional client-side region hint to help prevent misrouted requests. Troubleshooting docs updated with remediation guidance and sample audit-event correlation fields.
body:
Title: SDK: typed exceptions for data residency enforcement + optional client region hint

Context
Data residency enforcement is rolling out on Hosted/Dedicated. The API gateway now returns machine-readable error codes for residency violations (e.g. RESIDENCY_REGION_MISMATCH). Today the Python SDK raises a generic APIError and customers end up parsing strings, which makes it hard to implement correct retry/backoff behavior and causes noisy Support escalations (see SUP-3988).

This PR adds:
1) Typed exceptions for residency-related errors, mapped from error.code
2) Optional client-side region hint to reduce accidental cross-region requests (esp. when customers copy a US base URL but are pinned to EU)
3) Troubleshooting updates with concrete remediation steps and what to include when filing a ticket

Related
- Linear: ENG-2847
- API/Gateway work: redwood/pr_18435 (error codes + payload structure)
- Docs: aligns with the public docs content being added in redwood-docs/pr_388

User-facing changes
- New exceptions:
  - ResidencyError (base class)
  - ResidencyRegionMismatchError (RESIDENCY_REGION_MISMATCH)
  - ResidencyPolicyRequiredError (RESIDENCY_POLICY_REQUIRED)
  - ResidencyDeniedError (RESIDENCY_POLICY_DENY)
  - ResidencyCrossRegionFallbackDisabledError (RESIDENCY_CROSS_REGION_FALLBACK_DISABLED)

- New client option:
  - Redwood(client_region_hint="eu-west")
  - Also supported via env var: REDWOOD_REGION_HINT
  - Hint is sent as a request header: X-Redwood-Client-Region (best-effort; does not override server policy)

Notes on semantics
- We do NOT implement automatic retries or cross-region fallbacks in the SDK. The enforcement contract is intended to be deterministic when pinning is enabled.
- The region hint exists to help routing and provide earlier diagnostics. The server remains the source of truth.

Implementation details
- Introduce an error factory that inspects the standard error payload shape:
  - error.code (string)
  - error.message (string)
  - error.details (optional)
  - error.request_id (string)
  - error.docs_url (string)

- Residency exceptions preserve original fields for programmatic handling:
  - code, message
  - request_id
  - details (kept as a dict internally; exposed as a string representation in __str__ and repr to avoid surprising nested serialization in logs)

- Add typed exception tests covering:
  - mapping per code
  - unknown code falls back to APIError
  - SDK includes X-Redwood-Client-Region when configured
  - docs_url and request_id propagate into exception string

Illustrative snippet (new mapping)
- If the API responds with code RESIDENCY_REGION_MISMATCH, we now raise:
  ResidencyRegionMismatchError: "Request denied: org is pinned to eu-west but request was sent to us-east. Fix: use the eu-west base URL or set client_region_hint='eu-west'. request_id=req_... docs=https://docs.redwoodinference.com/data-residency"

Files / areas changed (high level)
- redwood_sdk/errors.py
  - Add ResidencyError hierarchy and mapping table
- redwood_sdk/_http.py
  - Inject X-Redwood-Client-Region header when client_region_hint is set
  - Error handling calls new error factory
- redwood_sdk/client.py
  - Accept client_region_hint
  - Read REDWOOD_REGION_HINT env var
- tests/test_residency_errors.py
  - New unit tests for mapping + header injection
- docs/troubleshooting.md
  - Add section: "Data residency enforcement errors"
  - Include checklist + sample payload fields to provide Support (request_id, org_id, pinned_region/allowed_regions, endpoint URL)
- README.md
  - Add a short note and link to troubleshooting section

Troubleshooting doc updates (summary)
- Common causes:
  - Wrong base URL/region endpoint used by the app
  - Multiple services in the same app configured with different regions
  - Stale config in CI/CD env vars
- Recommended fixes:
  - Use the correct regional base URL from Console
  - Set client_region_hint to match pinned region
  - Confirm org policy (pinned_region / allowed_regions) with compliance admin
- What to send Support:
  - request_id
  - timestamp + region
  - the exception type + code
  - whether client_region_hint was set

Backward compatibility
- No breaking API changes. Existing code catching APIError will still work (new errors inherit from APIError).
- client_region_hint is optional and defaults to None.

Security / privacy
- Region hint header is non-sensitive and only reflects customer-configured intent.
- Exception messages avoid echoing request bodies. We only include request_id, code, and non-sensitive fields from error.details.

Checklist
- [x] Unit tests added
- [x] Type hints updated
- [x] Docs updated
- [x] Changelog entry

Commits
- 9b2e8b1 Add residency exception classes + mapping factory
- 1c70d0e Add client_region_hint option + header injection
- f5a0a9d Unit tests for residency mapping + request header
- 2a19326 Docs: troubleshooting guidance for residency enforcement
- 7f8c4a2 Changelog + README updates

CI
- python-lint (ruff): pass
- mypy: pass
- unit tests (pytest): pass
- packaging/build: pass

Review conversation (highlights)
- Brian Murphy: "Please ensure we don't retry on these errors and the exception string includes request_id + docs_url; customers need actionable remediation." 
  - Ibrahim Khan: "Done. No retry logic added; request_id/docs_url now included in __str__."
- Monica Patel: "Can we support env var configuration for region hint for easier rollout?" 
  - Ibrahim Khan: "Added REDWOOD_REGION_HINT with precedence: explicit param > env var. Added tests."
- Marcus Lin: "Avoid including allowed_regions if it can be large; also ensure no payload echo." 
  - Ibrahim Khan: "We only include a truncated summary in __str__ and preserve raw details on the exception object; no request content logged."
- Wei Chen: "Docs: add a code snippet showing handling for ResidencyRegionMismatchError and link to residency docs." 
  - Ibrahim Khan: "Added snippet + link in docs/troubleshooting.md and README."

Merge
- Merged via squash on 2025-02-03 by Monica Patel
